note: How a student hackathon at Caltech, first sponsored by Anthropic and OpenAI to attack open problems with AI, drew an open letter calling for its suspension, then was redesigned with its critics as “Old Problems, New Proofs”: new proofs and explanations of known results, funded by XTX Markets and SAIR after the AI companies left. The event runs on 13–15 November.
title: In Caltech ‘Mathathon’ saga, AI early adopters and critics find common ground
